semiconductor_relevance: High — PIE Co., Ltd. provides advanced inspection and measurement equipment specifically designed for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: PIE Co., Ltd. specializes in AI-driven inspection solutions for the semiconductor industry, offering a comprehensive lineup of equipment that includes holotomography, X-ray CT, and ultrasonic inspection systems. Their technology is aimed at ensuring high-speed, high-precision quality assurance for glass-core substrates, advanced packaging, and PCBs.
capabilities: X-ray computed tomography (CT) for defect detection

regional_presence.Korea: Headquartered in Dongtan, Korea, with an AI R&D campus in Pangyo.
regional_presence.United States: Has a subsidiary in the United States.
